reference_policy: Reuse original archived success rows and per-pair records; never rerun reference learning.
arm: Shortened full-model HER at p=2/3; independent post-ALP per-rule reward skips with maze-specific pi on actual relabeled draws only, ignoring goal attributes. Originals and fallbacks update every rule. ALP, GA, q, order and full-next-match-set bootstrap stay unchanged.
randomness: Independent seed-derived ChaCha8 stream 0x726577617264736b. Policy stream1 and sampler stream7 retain S construction. Skip RNG state and counters participate in read-only evaluation snapshots.
counters: Every row records original/relabeled macroclassifier reward updates and skips by both rule kinds, post-ALP action-set opportunities, and relabeled draws containing a goal-specific rule.

success.primary: Equal-weight checkpoint mean within seed, every registered checkpoint.

analysis.pooling: Concatenate training, validation and test; retain recorded pair weights, giving equal mass to blocks even with unequal block sizes.
analysis.F_mod: Optimality of weighted within-start modal action among nonfallbacks; lowest action index breaks modal ties.
analysis.estimate_minus_q: Estimate minus capped Q* for chosen first action; all pairs including fallbacks.
analysis.estimate_above_v: Strict binary64 estimate > capped V* among nonfallbacks.
analysis.within_start_slope: Weighted within-start covariance(estimate,Q*) / within-start variance(Q*); all pairs including fallbacks.
analysis.winner_goal_mass: Weighted share of ALL first decisions credited to a winner specifying a goal attribute. Tied classifier winners share equally, without numerosity weighting; fallbacks contribute zero.
analysis.intervals: Pair by seed before computing sample SE. Marginal 95% t(19) success and t(4) mechanism intervals, no multiplicity correction. Undefined seed metrics invalidate the interval; never drop or impute.

dose.aggregation: Equal-weight mean of per-seed cumulative opportunity shares; R minus G paired by seed for the all-opportunity check.
dose.relabeled: R skipped_with_goal + skipped_without_goal divided by R relabeled action_set_rules; compare absolute mean difference with registered pi.
dose.all: R total skips / R all opportunities minus G total skips / G all opportunities.
dose.violation: Strictly greater than either tolerance is a stated limitation on that maze, never silently discarded.

outcome.counts: A+ and A- count G-R intervals strictly above and below zero; B+ counts R-S intervals strictly above zero.

analysis.mechanism_rule: On at least three of maze4, maze5, maze6, maze7, G-R intervals are strictly positive for BOTH F_mod and winner_goal_mass on the same maze.
analysis.interpretation: R also removes some copy rewards from goal-blind rules. R-S > 0 alone does not identify update count as the cause. G-R is the deciding contrast.
analysis.labels: Only these contrasts, dose checks and decision rules are registered. Everything else is post hoc.

forecast.expected_rule: Nineteen replications of each measured seed42 CPUTimeRAW; conservatively retain per-pair overhead for compact runs.
forecast.hard_rule: max(3,ceil((2*collector wall seconds+60)/60)) per maze; every array reserves its largest cell limit for every job.
forecast.limitation: One cost seed cannot bound seed variance. All attempts, spent allocations, remaining reservations and new hard limits must fit the separately approved cumulative limit.

execution.source: Pinned clean measurement commit and unchanged static binary; frozen operations per stage.
execution.grouping: One 24-job diagnostic array (six mazes x seeds43--46), then three 30-job compact arrays (two mazes x seeds47--61). At most two streams and forty running jobs.
execution.admission: Re-derive manifests from approved registration before each sbatch; grant, expanded queue, scheduler test-only, node guards and shared STOP. Pilot + spent + reservations + new hard limits within cumulative approved CPU-hour limit.
execution.accounting: Every attempt, CPUTimeRAW allocated CPU-seconds, sacct deduplicated by JobIDRaw. Two independently checksum-verified archive copies.

stage2_deliverables: registered paired contrasts and exact outcome/mechanism decisions
F and F_mod curves over training for R against G and S
authorization: Stage1 ends after this single plan with its forecast and the external report. No seed beyond42 is authorized without explicit stage2 approval of these plan bytes and a CPU-hour limit.
